skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of environmental accounting and natural capital accounting.
Understand the necessity and tools of EMA for businesses.
Understand the structure and components of SEEA.
Master the process and methods of material flow and energy accounting.
Master the process and methods of environmental cost accounting.
Master the process and methods of environmental investment appraisal.
Master the process and methods of natural capital accounting.
Develop skills in working in groups on practical environmental management scenarios.
Develop skills in independent study, research, and experience accumulation.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze environmental and economic impacts.
Develop communication skills through writing reports and giving presentations.
Develop personal responsibility and social responsibility.
